entities.name: Protonated piperazinone benzoate
observations: For the submitted protonated stereochemical SMILES, the indicated name is methyl 3-[[2-[(2S)-3-oxopiperazin-1-ium-2-yl]acetyl]amino]benzoate.
The profile tool neutralized the ring nitrogen, so its neutral name does not preserve the input +1 charge.
